steps.en: Buy a licence for 25€, or compile the source yourself for free
steps.zh: 花 25€ 买授权，或自行免费编译源码

steps.en: Loads your installed packages with its own loader rather than through brew
steps.zh: 用自带的加载器读取已安装包，而不是走 brew

steps.en: Tag packages, update only the ones you pick, add taps, manage services
steps.zh: 给包打标签、只更新你挑的那些、加 tap、管理 services

steps.en: Runs the brew operations and refreshes the package list afterwards
steps.zh: 执行 brew 操作，随后刷新包列表

steps.en: Keeps updating from the menu bar while the main window is closed
steps.zh: 主窗口关着也能从菜单栏继续更新

value.en: Tagging, services, proxy-aware downloads and menu-bar updates that brew itself does not give you
value.zh: 标签、services、遵守系统代理的下载和菜单栏更新——brew 本身给不了这些
